description: A full-featured file manager component with folder tree navigation, list/grid views, toolbar actions, and breadcrumb path display. Supports keyboard navigation like Windows Explorer (arrow keys, Enter, Delete, F2, Ctrl+A, Backspace, Ctrl+Click, Shift+Click).

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Event fired when the selection changes.

parameters.name: CurrentPath
parameters.description: Data provider for file system operations.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Event fired when the view mode changes.

parameters.name: OnItemOpen
parameters.description: Whether to show the Rename button. Default is true.

parameters.name: OnSelectionChanged
parameters.description: Event fired when an item is opened (double-clicked).

parameters.name: ShowDeleteButton
parameters.description: Whether to show the Upload button. Default is true.

parameters.name: ShowFolderTree
parameters.description: When true, disables all user interactions.

parameters.name: ShowNewFolderButton
parameters.description: Whether to show the folder tree sidebar. Default is true.

parameters.name: ShowRenameButton
parameters.description: Whether to show the Delete button. Default is true.

parameters.name: ShowUploadButton
parameters.description: Whether to show the New Folder button. Default is true.

parameters.name: ViewMode
parameters.description: Event fired when the current path changes.

parameters.name: ViewModeChanged
parameters.description: Display mode (List or Grid). Default is .
